metadata.purpose: Turn source next(notification) into the represented downstream next, error or complete.

conditions: N forwards exactly one payload; E/C terminate immediately, even if the upstream would send more values.
An upstream ordinary complete or error is forwarded when no embedded terminal has arrived.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, resource release and cancellation are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: No arguments. Source values are well-formed RxJS Notification objects with kind N, E or C.
scope.callbacks: None. Notification payloads and error objects remain opaque.
scope.time: No scheduler or timer; synchronous arrival order controls termination.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source and callback outcome delivery; no observer/finalizer reentry inside the modeled reaction.
exclusions: Malformed notification objects and observer exceptions.
Nested synchronous reentry and delivery after terminal are rejected by the model.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One independently owned source connection is acquired at subscription, not construction.

ownership.sharing: None; independent operator state per subscription even if the upstream happens to be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh subscription starts with new state; closed execution rejects all subsequent model inputs.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Inspect only the protocol tag of each Notification; no payload transformation or timestamp creation.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications or completed synchronous logical microsteps; silent release only.
